## Retraction Watch Database

```{r rw-data}
# load retraction watch data
rw <- data.frame(read.csv(
  "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ashnryn/article-retractions/refs/heads/main/retraction-watch/retraction_watch.csv",
  na.strings = c("", "unavailable")
))

#### Retraction Watch entries without DOIs ####
rw <- rw |> filter(is.na(OriginalPaperDOI))

# What journals are represented?
rw |> count(Journal) |> arrange(desc(n)) |> head(20)

rw |> 
  filter(str_detect(Journal, pattern = "Conference")) |> 
  nrow() # Majority are conference papers

# Which countries are represented?
rw |> count(Country) |> 
  mutate(p = round(n / nrow(rw), 4)) |> 
  arrange(desc(n)) |>
  head(20) # Majority were published in China

# Min and max publication dates?
cbind(min.date = min(rw$OriginalPaperDate), 
      max.date = max(rw$OriginalPaperDate))

## The 1953 one is the "first ever english language retraction", per RW
## Benjamin Wilson, "Treatise upon Electricity"

## 2016 is "Expression of FPN and Hepcidin in breast cancer tissues and 
## association of their expression with occurrence of anemia", Shihui Ma, 
## Feihai Ling, et al.

# Add publication and retraction years
rw <- rw |>
  mutate(pub.year = ifelse(
    mdy_hm(OriginalPaperDate) %>% is.na(), 
    mdy_hms(OriginalPaperDate) %>% year() %>% as.integer(),
    mdy_hm(OriginalPaperDate) %>% year() %>% as.integer()),
    .after = OriginalPaperDate) |>
  mutate(ret.year = ifelse(
    mdy_hm(RetractionDate) %>% is.na(),
    mdy_hms(RetractionDate) %>% year() %>% as.integer(),
    mdy_hm(RetractionDate) %>% year() %>% as.integer()),
    .after = RetractionDate)

# Retractions without DOIs, by publication year
rw |>
  ggplot(aes(x = pub.year)) +
    geom_histogram(binwidth = 1, fill = "darkgreen") +
    theme_linedraw()

# Restrict to 2000-2026
rw |> filter(!is.na(pub.year)) |>
  filter(pub.year >= 2000 & pub.year <= 2026) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = pub.year)) +
    geom_histogram(binwidth = 1, fill = "darkgreen") +
    theme_linedraw()

# Majority were published in 2010 specifically??
rw |> count(pub.year) |> arrange(desc(n))
```

### Retraction Reasons

```{r ret-reasons, fig.height = 11, fig.width = 7}
source("read_reasons.R", local = knitr::knit_global())

# Pass retraction reasons column to count_reasons
reasons_tab <- count_reasons(rw$Reason)

# How many are image related?
reasons_tab[which(
  str_detect(reasons_tab$reason, pattern = "[Ii]mage")
  ),]

reasons_tab[which(
  str_detect(reasons_tab$reason, pattern = "[Ii]mage")
  ),]$n |> sum()

reasons_tab |> ggplot(aes(x = reorder(reason, n), y = n)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "rosybrown") +
  labs(x = "Reason", y = "Count") +
  coord_flip() +
  theme_linedraw()
```

### Retraction Reasons - Compare to full RW dataset

```{r rw-full, fig.height = 12, fig.width = 7}
# load retraction watch data
rw_full <- data.frame(read.csv(
  "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ashnryn/article-retractions/refs/heads/main/retraction-watch/retraction_watch.csv",
  na.strings = c("", "unavailable")
))

# Pass full retraction reasons column to count_reasons
reasons_tab_full <- count_reasons(rw_full$Reason)

reasons_tab_full |> ggplot(aes(x = reorder(reason, n), y = n)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "rosybrown") +
  labs(x = "Reason", y = "Count") +
  coord_flip() +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 1)) +
  theme_linedraw()
```



```{r reasons-crosstab, cache = TRUE, fig.width = 10}
reason_cross <- reasons_crosstab(rw$Reason, reasons_tab$reason)
reason_cross_full <- reasons_crosstab(rw_full$Reason, reasons_tab_full$reason)

reason_cross_prop <- crosstab_proportions(reason_cross, reasons_tab)
reason_cross_full_prop <- crosstab_proportions(reason_cross_full, reasons_tab_full) |>
  data.frame()

reason_cross_prop |> 
  mutate(row = rownames(reason_cross_prop), .before = 1) |>
  reshape2::melt(id.vars = "row") |>
  mutate(value = round(value, digits = 4)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = row, y = variable, fill = value)) +
    geom_tile() +
    scale_x_discrete(breaks = seq(0, 90, by = 3)) +
    scale_y_discrete(breaks = seq(0, 90, by = 3))
```

```{r write-crosstabs, eval = FALSE}
write.csv(reason_cross, "crosstabs/reason_cross_no_doi.csv", row.names = TRUE)
write.csv(reason_cross_full, "crosstabs/reason_cross_full.csv", row.names = TRUE)
write.csv(reason_cross_prop, "crosstabs/reason_cross_prop_no_doi.csv", row.names = TRUE)
write.csv(reason_cross_full_prop, "crosstabs/reason_cross_prop_full.csv", row.names = TRUE)
```
